cd /app && python3 -c "
import mteb, warnings, collections
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
b=[x for x in mteb.get_benchmarks() if x.name=='MTEB(Scandinavian, v1)'][0]
res=mteb.load_results(results_repo='/tmp/results', download_latest=False, tasks=b.tasks).join_revisions()
scores=res.get_scores(format='long')
alltasks=set(t.metadata.name for t in b.tasks)
print('benchmark tasks', len(alltasks))
present_tasks=set(s['task_name'] for s in scores)
print('present tasks', len(present_tasks))
print('missing from any:', alltasks-present_tasks)
# per model
d=collections.defaultdict(dict)
for s in scores:
    d[s['model_name']][s['task_name']]=s['score']
full=[(m, sum(v.values())/len(v)) for m,v in d.items() if set(v.keys())>=alltasks]
full.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])
print('num models with all tasks:', len(full))
for m,sc in full[:15]:
    print(round(sc*100,2), m)
" 2>&1 | grep -v Missing | tail -25
